premise: Bear cub doesn't want to miss a single thing all winter, but his yawns win; Badger digs him a cosy hollow, Flower folds up too, and when the spring sun comes they wake up together.
inspiration: Rip Van Winkle, turned: the long sleep is safe, a friend keeps a promise, and nothing good was missed.
lesson: Friends keep watch while you rest.
learning: Bears sleep through most of the winter.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Sleeps Till Spring
en-US.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} It was autumn, and the leaves {sfx:leaves} came twirling down. {bear:enter} Bear cub gave a great big yawn. {bear:face sad} [sad] "I don't want to sleep all winter. I'll miss everything!" {badger:enter} Badger trotted up. [warmly] "I'll wake you for the best bit. Promise." {badger:live dig} He dug a cosy hollow, just bear-sized. {badger:face happy} Beside them, {flower:enter} Flower {flower:tint #BFE3FF} shivered and {flower:live close hold} folded up her petals. "See you in spring," she whispered. {bear:face happy} So Bear cub sat down in the hollow and {bear:live nap hold} gave one last yawn. {canvas:leaves stop} {canvas:snow 0.7} Then the snowflakes came, and Bear cub slept all winter long, the way bears do. {sfx:snore} He slept… and slept… and slept. And Badger kept watch. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} One morning, the sun came back and melted the snow. {badger:go to bear} Badger tiptoed over. [whispers] "Wake up. It's the best bit." {bear:live nap resume} Bear cub woke with a start. {flower:live close resume} Flower opened wide. {bear:face surprised} {bear:live talk} [gasps] "Did I miss it?" {badger:live laugh} "No," laughed Badger. "The best bit is now." {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} [happily] "Good morning, spring!"

es-ES.title: Osito duerme hasta la primavera
es-ES.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} Era otoño, y las hojas {sfx:leaves} caían dando vueltas. {bear:enter} Osito soltó un bostezo enorme. {bear:face sad} [sad] —No quiero dormir todo el invierno. ¡Me lo voy a perder todo! {badger:enter} Tejón llegó trotando. [warmly] —Yo te despierto para lo mejor. Te lo prometo. {badger:live dig} Y le cavó un hueco calentito, a la medida de un oso. {badger:face happy} Al lado, {flower:enter} Flor {flower:tint #BFE3FF} tiritó y {flower:live close hold} recogió sus pétalos. —Hasta la primavera —susurró. {bear:face happy} Así que Osito se sentó en el hueco y {bear:live nap hold} dio un último bostezo. {canvas:leaves stop} {canvas:snow 0.7} Luego llegaron los copos de nieve, y Osito durmió todo el invierno, como hacen los osos. {sfx:snore} Durmió… y durmió… y durmió. Y Tejón cuidaba de él. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Una mañana volvió el sol y derritió la nieve. {badger:go to bear} Tejón se acercó de puntillas. [whispers] —Despierta, Osito. Ya llega lo mejor. {bear:live nap resume} Osito se despertó de un respingo. {flower:live close resume} Flor se abrió de par en par. {bear:face surprised} {bear:live talk} [gasps] —¿Me lo he perdido? {badger:live laugh} —¡Qué va! —se rió Tejón—. Lo mejor es ahora. {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} [happily] —¡Buenos días, primavera!
